description: An agent's call center availability, kept per user and written on every change

agent_id.description: The user this document is about

availability.description: What the agent, a supervisor or an automatic rule chose

break_ends.description: When the break the agent is on ends by itself, in Gregorian seconds; set by a break given a timeout and removed by every other change

counters.description: Counters kept since the agent last logged in

last_call_end.description: When the agent's last queue call ended, in Gregorian seconds

missed.description: Offers missed since login, not counted while the agent is on break or logged out

talk_time_s.description: Seconds spent on queue calls since login

presence_id.description: Where the agent's login lamp is published, stored by a callcenter_agent callflow action that names one; overrides <prefix><user presence_id>

previous.description: The availability to restore when do-not-disturb is cleared

timestamp.description: When the availability last changed, in Gregorian seconds
